name: Marketplace
eComp: +1 Influence upon a successful trade with another player.
eVisitO: +1 resource of any kind upon a successful Trade.

name: Farm
eComp: +1 influence and +1 influence per adjacent farm

name: Housing
eVisitX: You may Build on any Tile this turn.
eVisitO: You may give the player on your Tile 1 Resource. If you do, gain 2 Resources of any type from the stockpile.

name: Pendantmaker
eVisitX: You may pay 4 Crystals to receive a Sigil.

name: Stoas
eVisitO: +1 Advantage Roll. (You can spend these on the same roll)

name: Aqueduct
eComp: Gain 1 Influence per Floodplain on the map.

name: Baths
eComp: Place a Floodplain. +1 influence for each adjacent Water Building, Floodplain, or Lake.
eVisitX: Change one adjacent flat tile to a floodplains.
eVisitO: You may dry or flood one adjacent plains or floodplains.

name: Apothecary
eVisitX: Give 1 Cursed Invitation to another player. (Pass off your own. Else, take the first one you find, then shuffle.)

name: University
eComp: Gain +2 of the same resource on Gathers.

name: Lighthouse
eComp: All unexplored tiles are Lake tiles for you.
eVisitX: Drown a tile (change any Buildable Tile into a Floodplains.)

name: Basilica
eComp: Adjust your Alignment to whatever you want. Your Alignment Adjusts give you +1 influence.
eVisitX: Adjust Alignment by 2. You may draw a Sigil.
eVisitO: You may Adjust your Alignment by 1.

name: Hippodrome
eComp: Gain +1 Influence when completing a Layer.
eVisitX: Trade as many Sigils as you had at the start of your turn 1:1 with the stockpile. Either Sigil can be of any type.
